issue.title: fakey — a first-class fake agent CLI provider for testing launches, failures, and retries
Phase 1 — The `fakey` CLI and scenario engine
Phase 4 — E2E retry pipeline harness and tests

fields.notes: Implemented standalone fakey CLI/scenario engine, persistent attempt state and invocation records, bundled scenarios, console script, barriers/timeouts, streaming/usage, failure markers, SIGTERM handling, and 24 focused tests. Verification: installed CLI smoke passed; tests/fakey 24 passed; full suite 16200 passed, 7 skipped. just check passes fmt/ruff/mypy/pyscripts and is blocked only by pre-existing unrelated pyvision warning for ChangeSpecProjectFile in src/sase/ace/changespec/discovery.py.

Added a reusable retry Agent fixture builder and five fixture-driven Agents-tab PNG goldens covering countdown RETRYING, active fallback, a completed retry chain, retries exhausted, and selected-row retry metadata, each with SVG text assertions. Visual review completed. Verification: just test-visual passed (161 passed, 1 skipped); formatting, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, pyvision, and pylimit passed. Full validation remains blocked by unrelated user-managed generated memory/shim drift; full pytest reached 16180 passed, 7 skipped with one reproducible unrelated loader-dedup baseline failure.

Completed Phase 3 first-class fakey provider integration. Added FakeyProvider with stdin transport, shared plain streaming and interrupt resume, FAKEY-USAGE parsing/artifact output, full effort mapping, model metadata/aliases, retry defaults, SASE_FAKEY_PATH and tier arg overrides, autodetect floor, and no-auth/no-skill provider metadata. Registered the sase_llm entry point; added badge, palette, doctor hints, commented retry config, provider docs, docs/fakey.md, and MkDocs navigation. Added real-subprocess provider coverage for success, retryable/non-retryable failures, usage, effort/args, path override, and barrier-driven interrupts, plus registry, doctor, retry-merge, and skill opt-out coverage. Added generic auth-not-required and skill-deployment opt-out support without fakey-specific shared orchestration branches. Corrected the pre-existing internal-only ChangeSpecProjectFile visibility issue surfaced by the mandatory pyvision gate. Verification: just install; focused provider/registry/doctor/skill-init suites; just docs-check; full just check (all formatting, lint, typing, validation, visual/unit tests) green.

Completed Phase 4 E2E retry pipeline coverage. Added tests/fakey/harness.py with isolated SASE home/workspace/artifacts/config, scenario and timeout-bounded barrier builders, background execution, retry-state polling, DONE/handoff/meta/attempt readers, and fakey invocation inspection. Added five run_execution_loop integration tests using real fakey subprocesses for fail-once recovery with continuation nudge and retry-state lifecycle, exhausted retries and attempt snapshots, fallback model switching, spawn_new_agent handoff/terminal parent artifacts, and kill during retry wait with no extra attempt. The detached launcher boundary is stubbed because full daemon/workspace-claim lifecycle is outside the isolated pytest sandbox; dedicated launcher tests cover that layer. Fixed shared prompt execution to honor the existing SASE_MODEL_OVERRIDE set by fallback retries, with no fakey-specific orchestration branch. Verification: just install; focused fakey/retry suite 136 passed; git diff --check; full just check green.

Implemented real-fakey retry PNG coverage for RETRYING countdown, running fallback, and completed spawn-on-retry chains; extended harness normalization/loader support; fixed generic live/terminal workflow dedup retry projection; documented harness usage. Verified with just test-visual and just check.
